context: Evaluates whether the agent fixes a proper question set, dispatches a research subagent with evidence-citation and repository-source-checking instructions, validates the schema output, and ends with exactly one non-hedging recommendation.

checklist.name: Question set fixed
checklist.description: Uses the default five dimensions or explicitly justifies a substitution

checklist.name: Subagent given exact identifiers and alternatives
checklist.description: Research subagent briefed with the concrete package names and the alternatives already considered

checklist.name: Evidence-citation instruction given
checklist.description: Subagent explicitly told to cite a file/line, URL, or doc section for every verdict

checklist.name: Repository-source check required
checklist.description: Subagent explicitly told to check the actual Terraform/bundling config rather than assume how Lambda bundling works

checklist.name: Schema validation run
checklist.description: validate-tech-evaluation.sh run against the subagent's YAML output before trusting it

checklist.name: Validation failure handling
checklist.description: If validation fails, sends it back to the subagent rather than hand-patching

checklist.name: Single non-hedging recommendation
checklist.description: Ends with exactly one of adopt/keep_current/reject/needs_more_research and a real rationale, not a comparison table
